ai_model.description: Model that generated the check, if AI-authored.

check_type.description:
Which assertion to make. Determines the shape of config; see /check_types/.

* `not_null` - not_null
* `unique` - unique
* `accepted_values` - accepted_values
* `relationships` - relationships
* `row_count` - row_count
* `freshness` - freshness
* `custom_sql` - custom_sql

column_name.description: Column the check applies to. Omit for table-scoped types like row_count.

confidence.description: AI author's confidence in the check, 0-1.

config.description: Type-specific configuration, validated against the check type's JSON schema.

created_source.description:
Whether a human ('user') or an agent ('ai_generated') authored this check.

* `user` - user
* `ai_generated` - ai_generated

description.description: Why this check exists and what a failure means.

enabled.description: Disabled checks are never run by any trigger.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this data quality check.

name.description: Optional identifier-safe handle, unique per project. Omit to address the check by id.

reasoning.description: AI author's reasoning, surfaced as review context.

severity.description:
'error' failures mark the subject failing and notify; 'warn' failures only surface.

* `error` - error
* `warn` - warn

tags.description: Free-form string labels for grouping and filtering.
